topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture on cancer evolution and outlines the core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic alterations in cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications drive clonal fitness and tumor progression.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and the cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how stemness, cellular hierarchy, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how non-mutational environmental factors, chronic inflammation, and supportive stromal interactions enable tumor outgrowth.

topics.label: Technological approaches to studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the experimental, single-cell, and spatial omics methods used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated multifactorial model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the interplay among mutational burden, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental conditions in driving cancer.
